_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, these six brands operate a combined 43 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 105,750 berths as of December 31, 2014'; 'We compete principally on the basis of exceptional service provided by our crew, innovation and quality of ships, variety of itineraries, choice of destinations and price'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic and geopolitical conditions' (its own FY2014 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, these six brands operate a combined 43 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 105,750 berths as of December 31, 2014'; 'We compete principally on the basis of exceptional service provided by our crew, innovation and quality of ships, variety of itineraries, choice of destinations and price'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic and geopolitical conditions' (its own FY2014 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 29.97x; +82% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.53; conservative 2yr -12%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -73.5%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.7%/yr (Q4 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +11.7%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +97.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2015-12-18) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 29.97x (96.9% downside to Bear $3 / +3.2% upside to Bull $99) | Adj composite 2.25 vs market 2.78: gap -0.53 [OVERVALUED] | +82% above the EPP floor $53 (11x FY15E $4.80) | Conservative 2-yr case: -12.4% total (-6.2%/yr) | At 20.0x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $127 sits above the BULL case; Net Yields +0.2% in Q3 2015, forward net revenue +10.87-11.41% (Q4 2015 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
